title: Agent Execution Chain
definition: A sequence of software programs, or agents, that work together to complete a task.

difficulty_levels.beginner: An agent execution chain is a sequence of software programs that work together to complete a task.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: An agent execution chain is a sequence of software agents that work together to process and interpret data.
difficulty_levels.expert: An agent execution chain is a fundamental concept in distributed artificial intelligence. It highlights the challenges and opportunities associated with the synchronization, coordination, and communication between software agents.

extra_fields.insight: The agent execution chain is a key concept in the design and implementation of distributed artificial intelligence systems.
